facts.text: Franciscan operates an Austrian study abroad program based at the Kartause, a restored fourteenth-century Carthusian monastery in Gaming, Austria.

sources.title: Austria Study Abroad | Franciscan University of Steubenville
sources.quote: Nestled in the heart of Austria's breathtaking alpine countryside, the Kartause is a beautifully restored 14th century Carthusian monastery that serves as the home of Franciscan University's Austrian Program.
sources.closest: heart and mind through the franciscan study abroad program you'll have a life-changing experience learning about history, culture, the world - and yourself. you'll live and learn in the kartause, a restored 14th century carthusian monastery in the foothills
